When making file changes in this project:

1. Always suggest a Git commit title in LESS THAN 10 WORDS.
2. Also generate an extended commit description.
3. The description MUST include:

   * What changed
   * Why it changed
   * Files/components affected
   * AI platform used

Commit title format:
[type]: short summary

Examples:
feat: add ai image page
fix: repair login redirect
style: improve dashboard layout

Extended description format:

* Added responsive AI dashboard cards
* Improved sidebar navigation performance
* Updated API fetch handling
* Modified:

  * pages/ai/index.tsx
  * components/sidebar.tsx

Change made by AI vibe code
